oracle_semantics: the precision anchor is the independent continuous-sigma DOP853 reference pipeline; LSODA is only a regression/runtime anchor, never a precision oracle

fast_plain_grid.definition: maximum practical speed under a documented accuracy envelope; fixed/plain frequency grid, no expensive transition refinement, reduced frequency nodes and ODE steps; NOT a gross-error mode

accuracy.source: docs/paramsweep_plain/validation_summary.json (9 matched z8 points vs continuous-sigma reference)

fast_plain_grid.regime_map: plain-grid is safe only for exploratory coverage of the signal shape; it carries a ~7e-3 .. 3e-2 relative DN_gw / spectrum bias from the fixed sigma grid across the reheating kink, so it is NOT certified for science or MCMC

fast_transition_refine.definition: default scientific-production solver; transition-aware kink breakpoint, phase_max-capped horizon-crossing sub-stepping, adaptive frequency grid, per-solve local error estimate; built for Cobaya / MCMC
fast_transition_refine.regime_map: transition-refine is certified in the posterior-bulk / signal region to ~7e-4 (signal rel) and ~4.3e-4 (integrated DN_gw median); the axis-edge suite has a single 1.64e-3 signal-rel outlier (edge_r_hi) and 2 explicit shared-Neff guard rejections, so a certified band requires the local error / quadratic escalation
fast_transition_refine.oracle_tail_caveat: the reference oracle itself carries ~3e-4 frozen-tail z_tail sensitivity, i.e. the production fast residual (~4e-4 integrated DN_gw) is at the same level as the oracle's own model choice.

honest_limits.note: integrated DN_gw relative < 1e-4 is NOT met (median 4.3e-4): the residual is at the level of the reference's own z_tail frozen-tail sensitivity (~3-4e-4), not a tuning artifact

fast_current_audit.definition: current formal fast path; this section is the active HEAD audit, while the legacy profiles below are retained for historical compatibility

estimator_coverage.definition: predicted relative DN error from the fast telemetry compared with same-grid independent reference error

parameter_space_oracle.definition: same-grid independent continuous-sigma DOP853 reference on additional named/tilt/Sobol points

oracle_tail_sensitivity.interpretation: z_tail=5 and z_tail=8 reference variants are not interchangeable precision anchors; the fast residual must be reported with this oracle-choice caveat.

candidate_grid_seed78.reason: 89-node seed78 plus PCHIP remains above the DN <2e-4 target on the independent default oracle.

outer_reuse_safety.definition: reuse=true versus always-full solve; false-safe means DN rel >2e-4, spectrum max rel >1e-3, or any failure

phase_cap_candidate.reason: Neither larger phase cap achieved a stable >5% runtime improvement across the six-point matrix.

honest_limits: DN <2e-4 is not established across the audited regimes.
warm median <4 ms is not established.
PCHIP remains opt-in; no global quadrature promotion.
